overview: The Grimling Encampment is the primary staging ground for Grimling raids into Dawnshroud Peaks.
details: Warbands gather here, beast handlers prepare their pets, and shamans perform rituals to empower raiders.
hooks: A Grimling warlord rallies multiple warbands.
A ritual pit glows with strange twilight energy.
Captured Vah Shir scouts are held in a bone cage.
